jobs.description:
Our client is a prestigious law firm based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

As a German-speaking Partner Secretary, your responsibilities are:

• Manage the Partner's agenda and coordinate meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements
• Handle correspondence, emails, and phone calls in German and English
• Prepare and format legal documents, presentations, and reports
• Organize and maintain digital and physical filing systems
• Liaise with clients and internal departments in a professional and confidential manner
• Assist with billing and time entry
• Support in the organization of events and internal meetings

• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a similar role, ideally within a law firm or professional services environment
• You speak German with an excellent command of English (spoken and written); French is a plus
• Strong organizational and communication skills
• Proficient in MS Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
• Discreet, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure with a high level of professionalism

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3  years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

Support the CEO and executive leadership team by ensuring the smooth coordination of administrative, organizational, marketing, and operational activities.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established organization operating in a dynamic and professional environment, offering a central role with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making.

Description

• Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, and appointments.
• Coordinate recurring management, board, and shareholder meetings.
• Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including urgent matters.
• Maintain and update key contacts and administrative records.
• Prepare meeting materials and coordinate attendees.
• Support telephone reception and general administrative tasks.
• Assist with marketing activities, including client events, website management, and LinkedIn communications.
• Coordinate facility-related projects and external service providers across offices.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good level of English.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly organized.
• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy.
• Strong communication skills and comfortable working with senior stakeholders.

Our client is a global life sciences organization providing specialized research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies. The company is recognized for its scientific expertise and commitment to supporting innovation across the drug development process. The client is based in Schaerbeek.

Jobomschrijving

• Prospect and identify new business opportunities using available sales tools and market intelligence.
• Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients within your assigned territory.
• Work closely with the commercial team to execute business development strategies and support customer acquisition initiatives.
• Manage customer interactions through CRM tools, ensuring accurate follow-up, pipeline management and reporting.
• Serve as the main point of contact for prospects, understanding their needs and proposing suitable solutions.
• Respond to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner, providing information, quotations and commercial support.
• Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing and prospective accounts.
• Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions when required.
• Deliver presentations and participate in customer meetings to promote the company's products and services.
• Represent the company at selected industry events, conferences and trade shows to expand network opportunities and generate leads.
• Contribute to the growth of the business by developing new accounts and nurturing long-term customer relationships.

• BS degree in biology or life sciences related fields, or equivalent level of experience.
• Proven work experience as a sales support specialist or customer support associate.
• Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems and proficiency with MS suite incl. Excel.
• In-depth understanding and track record of best-in-class customer services.
• Excellent communication (verbal and in writing., and proficiency in English language).
• Analytical, motivational and multitasking skills.
• Teamwork and customer relationships development capabilities.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and industry events.
• A second European language is a plus.

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll play a key role in connecting top talent with the right opportunities. You'll manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing and interviewing candidates, to advising clients and closing successful placements.

Client Details

You will be joining a small division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row and located in the hearth of Brussels.

Description

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Building and maintaining strong relationships with both clients and candidates

• 
Managing recruitment processes from A to Z

• 
Advising clients on market trends, salary benchmarks and hiring strategies

• 
Actively sourcing talent through various channels and conducting interviews

• 
Collaborating with a high-performing team in a supportive and ambitious environment

We are looking for a (Junior) Recruitment Consultant that :

• 
You speak French and English fluently (Dutch is a strong plus)

• 
You have a strong sense of initiative, and you thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

• 
You enjoy building relationships and helping others succeed

• 
A first experience in sales, recruitment, or a customer-facing role is a plus - but not a must!

• 
You are motivated, resilient, and eager to grow both personally and professionally

Our client is an international organisation operating within the consumer goods and retail sector.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Participate in purchasing and commercial projects with a focus on value creation and business performance.
• Coordinate and facilitate discussions between various stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
• Support negotiations, prepare relevant documentation and follow up on agreed actions.
• Analyse data and market insights to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
• Prepare presentations, reports and recommendations for management and project teams.
• Contribute to innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure effective communication and collaboration across all parties involved.
• Support the implementation and monitoring of strategic business initiatives.

Successful Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related field.
• 2-5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, FMCG, retail, category management, account management, commercial, or project management roles.
• Strong business acumen with an interest in purchasing, negotiations, and strategic stakeholder management.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and manage multiple stakeholders.
• Advanced Excel skills and a data-driven mindset.
• Pragmatic, proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable operating in an international environment.
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages such as Dutch or German are a plus.

jobs.occupation: Credit Risk Analyst - International Banking - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is an international corporate and investment banking institution with a strong presence across EMEA. The Belgian office acts as a strategic regional booking center and works closely with international stakeholders across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.The organization combines a highly professional banking environment with a collaborative and multicultural culture. Decision-making is thoughtful and risk-conscious, with a strong focus on compliance, integrity, teamwork, respect, diversity, equity & inclusion, and long-term client relationships.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze corporate lending and transaction requests from a credit risk perspective.
• Assess financial performance, business models, cash flows, and transaction structures.
• Prepare credit applications and recommendations for local credit committees.
• Monitor portfolio developments and identify emerging credit risks.
• Collaborate closely with Relationship Managers across Europe.
• Work alongside Compliance, Risk Management, Treasury, and Operations teams.
• Ensure transactions comply with internal risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
• Support continuous improvement of credit assessment processes and reporting.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• As from 2 years of experience in Credit Analysis, Corporate Banking, Risk for large companies
• Strong understanding of financial statements, credit risk fundamentals, and financial analysis.
• Ability to assess creditworthiness and formulate balanced risk recommendations.
• Excellent analytical skills and high attention to detail.
• Fluent in English with at least one additional European language.
• Proactive, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities.
• Team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Diligent, professional, intellectually curious, and commercially aware.

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

Our client is an EU organization based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage administrative mailboxes and general office correspondence.
• Register and review invoices while maintaining accurate supplier records.
• Prepare payments and support budget and expense management activities.
• Liaise with external accountants and maintain accounting documentation.
• Manage membership fees, donations and other contributions.
• Monitor contracts, deadlines, renewals and procurement procedures.
• Prepare and maintain administrative and financial reports, trackers and overviews.
• Review project documentation to ensure contracts, invoices and supporting documents are complete and properly filed.
• Support the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and public authorities.
• Coordinate office suppliers, equipment, inventory and external service providers.
• Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
• Maintain well-organised administrative records and contribute to the improvement of internal procedures and workflows.
• Provide general administrative, operational and compliance support as required.

• Minimum 1-2 years of experience in administration, office management or accounting support.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Good command of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Reliable, proactive and solution-oriented approach.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

Our client is a highly respected international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and client service. With a collaborative and professional culture, the firm combines high standards with a supportive working environment where people are encouraged to take ownership and make an impact.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the daily operations of the Brussels office
• Lead and support administrative and office services teams
• Oversee facilities, office maintenance, and workplace experience
• Coordinate suppliers, contractors, and external service providers
• Manage vendor relationships, tenders, and contract negotiations
• Monitor office budgets, expenses, and operational costs
• Organise office events, meetings, and internal initiatives
• Drive process improvements and operational efficiency projects
• Ensure compliance with health & safety and local regulations
• Coordinate onboarding and support employee experience initiatives
• Act as the main contact for landlords, building management, and external stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with leadership and international support teams
• Support business continuity, ESG, and office governance initiatives
• Coordinate local IT-related office needs and employee support

• Minimum 10 years of experience within a law firm, consultancy, or similar professional services environment
• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken (mandatory)
• Dutch is a strong asset
• Previous people management or team leadership experience
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset
• Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Professional, discreet, and service-driven
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office and digital tools
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.
